about_the_game:
Explore the world of interesting characters with relationship issues and needs.

Help out some of the girls in the game world or have fun with them.

Talk to beautiful girls and build your relationship with them.

Train at gym to become a better fighter.

Go into crime alley to find brothel and other fun stuff.

Add to your wishlist now!

Main Characters

  • MC ([player name]) – The protagonist, an aspiring MMA fighter uncovering the truth about his father.

  • George – MC’s father, a legendary fighter who mysteriously disappeared.

  • Dana Redd – The corrupt fight promoter and manager, responsible for manipulating fighters, including MC’s father.

  • Richard Manager – Replaces Dana as the arena’s manager after Dana disappears.

Fighters & Rivals

  • Konor – A brash, arrogant fighter who becomes the new champion under Dana’s manipulation.

  • Sagot Chama – An undefeated Muay Thai fighter involved in MC’s father's downfall.

  • Rampage Mike – A boxer and ranked opponent, one of MC’s biggest rivals.

  • Rick Wild (Diamond Wild) – A skilled brawler 

  • Weasel – A weak, first-ranked fighter, Anna’s perverted son who dreams of being strong.

Women & Romance Interests

  • Anna – A red-haired, 36-year-old single mother,  of anna and weasel

  • Aniya – Anna’s 18-year-old daughter, an aspiring model stuck in a twisted Hollywood scene.

  • Rose – Wife of officer diaz with a complicated past, involved in an NTR storyline.

  • Leza Boyle – A dominant and cunning shopkeeper who sells BDSM gear and hires female models.

  • Nisha – A fit, street-smart girl connected to Weasel’s storyline, later becomes his wife.

  • Flecia – A nurse who to heal MC and has secret for the game main story

  • Sherry - another brothel worker

Antagonists & Manipulators

  • Harvey – A creepy Hollywood agent exploiting Aniya.

  • Diaz – Rose’s ex-husband, who humiliates her after discovering her affair.

  • Thug – A minor antagonist or side character connected to underground activities.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

MMA Life Simulator

MMA Life Simulator is an adult visual novel mixed with MMA fighting simulation and choice-driven storytelling. Players step into the role of an up-and-coming fighter navigating the brutal underground fight scene while dealing with a web of complex relationships, business ventures, and dark secrets.

The game blends intense combat progression with erotic encounters, giving players control over their fighting career and personal life. Choices impact the MC’s relationships, financial status, and dominance inside and outside the ring.

Key Features:

  • Fight System: Train, improve stats, and battle ranked opponents to rise through the MMA ranks.

  • Main Storyline: Unravel the mystery of the MC’s missing father, a legendary fighter, while dealing with Dana Redd’s manipulation and rivals like Konor.

  • Erotic Content: Engage in explicit, choice-driven scenes with female characters like Anna, Aniya, Rose, Leza, and Nisha.

  • Business & Money: Own and profit from ventures like Leza’s shop and the brothel, affecting income and influence.

  • Dark Themes & Power Dynamics: Explore themes of control, betrayal, submission, and dominance in a morally grey world.

A game where strength alone isn’t enough—strategy, lust, and power plays determine the true champion.
